data.desc: EoCene Ltd. (NASDAQ: EOCN) is a GI-focused medtech and biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Ramat Gan, Israel, dedicated to advancing innovative solutions across gastrointestinal disease management, GI oncology and related therapeutic areas. The Company is building a diversified platform that combines medical devices, therapeutics and enabling technologies to address significant unmet clinical needs and improve patient outcomes. EoCene's wholly owned subsidiary, Colospan Ltd., is a commercial-stage medical device company developing solutions designed to transform postoperative colorectal care. Its flagship product, CG-100, is an intraluminal bypass device intended to protect colorectal anastomoses and reduce the need for diverting stomas, offering a less invasive alternative to current surgical practice.
